content.title: 7-1-2-2. Permission to use right-of-way.
content.summary: For WCFs in the right-of-way, the Applicant shall execute a Master License Agreement with the City. In this, the City is able to grant a non-exclusive license to the Applicant to use the right-of-way for Small Cell Facilities.

faqs.a: For WCFs in the right-of-way, the Applicant shall execute a Master License Agreement with the City. In this, the City is able to grant a non-exclusive license to the Applicant to use the right-of-way for Small Cell Facilities. Attachment of WCFs on an existing street light pole, traffic signal, or similar structure shall require written evidence of a license, or other legal right or approval, to use such structure by its owner.
